<style id="gv-theme">:root{--gv-bg:#07080f;--gv-bg2:#0c0d1b;--gv-ink:#f4f1ff;--gv-muted:#b9b4d6;--gv-hair:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--gv-lav:#d9d1f6;--gv-hot:#ff2d95;--gv-orange:#ff8a3d;--gv-sun:#ffd23f;--gv-violet:#8b5cf6;--gv-lime:#f0ff9e;--gv-sky:#b8e8ff;--gv-grad:linear-gradient(178deg,#ffe66d 0%,#ff8a3d 32%,#ff2d95 64%,#8b5cf6 100%);--gv-btn:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff2d95,#ff8a3d);--gv-d:'Bebas Neue','Oswald',Impact,sans-serif;--gv-b:'Jost','Futura',system-ui,sans-serif;--gv-gut:clamp(18px,5vw,72px);--a:#ff2d95;--a2:#8b5cf6;--part:#ff8a3d;--ink:#f4f1ff}
html,body{background:var(--gv-bg)!important;color:var(--gv-ink)}
body.a-c57-gatto-editorial{font-family:var(--gv-b);background:var(--gv-bg)!important}
/* hide the old editorial layout; GATO VI layout replaces it */
main>section.hero:not(.gv-hero),main>.band.mq,main>#story,main>#receipts,main>#places,main>#after,main>section.poster,main>#famiglia{display:none!important}
.gv-grain{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;opacity:.06;mix-blend-mode:overlay;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}
/* header */
header.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(7,8,15,.72)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gv-hair)!important;color:var(--gv-ink)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
header.nav .brand span{font-family:var(--gv-d)!important;font-size:1.6rem!important;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--gv-ink)!important;font-weight:400!important}

header.nav .nav-links a{font-family:var(--gv-d)!important;font-size:1.08rem!important;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gv-muted)!important;font-weight:400!important;background:none!important;border:0!important}
header.nav .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--gv-ink)!important}
header.nav .nav-links a.gv-vi{background:var(--gv-grad)!important;-webkit-background-clip:text!important;background-clip:text!important;color:transparent!important;font-size:1.35rem!important}
.btn,.copy-btn{font-family:var(--gv-d)!important;letter-spacing:.12em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;font-weight:400!important;font-size:1.08rem!important;border-radius:999px!important;border:1px solid var(--gv-hair)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;color:var(--gv-ink)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.btn.btn-ink,.btn.btn-gold,.gv-btn--p{background:var(--gv-btn)!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(255,45,149,.35)!important}
.btn .dexic{border-radius:50%;background:#fff}
/* generic */
.gv-wrap{width:min(1240px,100% - 2*var(--gv-gut));margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2}
.gv-eyebrow{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gv-muted)}
.gv-h2{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6vw,5.2rem);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:.01em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:.25em 0 .3em;color:var(--gv-ink)}
.gv-lede{color:var(--gv-muted);font-size:clamp(1rem,1.3vw,1.15rem);line-height:1.65;max-width:60ch;font-weight:300}
.gv-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-family:var(--gv-d);font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gv-ink);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(7,8,15,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .35s;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.gv-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.gv-btn--p{border:0}
.gv-btn img{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}
.gv-link{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gv-ink);text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.gv-link::after{content:"→";transition:transform .3s}.gv-link:hover::after{transform:translateX(4px)}
.gv-rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px) scale(.985);transition:opacity .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.gv-rv.gv-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* hero */
.gv-hero{position:relative;min-height:calc(100svh - 64px);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;padding:80px var(--gv-gut) 110px;isolation:isolate;background:var(--gv-bg)}
.gv-hero__bg{position:absolute;inset:-4%;z-index:-2;background:url(assets/gpt-bg1.webp?v=ccebfccd) center/cover no-repeat;transform:scale(1.04);will-change:transform;animation:gvKen 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.gv-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 50% 45%,rgba(7,8,15,.15),rgba(7,8,15,.55) 70%,rgba(7,8,15,.92)),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,8,15,.25),rgba(7,8,15,0) 30%,rgba(7,8,15,.9) 100%)}
@keyframes gvKen{to{transform:scale(1.12) translate3d(-1.2%,-1%,0)}}
.gv-hero__in{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px;max-width:900px;perspective:900px}
.gv-title{width:min(560px,86vw);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6));transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .2s ease-out;animation:gvFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes gvFloat{50%{translate:0 -10px}}
.gv-hero h1.gv-tag{font-family:var(--gv-b);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.8vw,1.35rem);line-height:1.5;color:var(--gv-ink);max-width:40ch;margin:0;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.gv-tag b{background:var(--gv-grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;font-weight:600}

.gv-ca span{font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gv-hot)}
.gv-ca code{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--gv-ink);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:46vw}
.gv-ca button{font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.14em;background:var(--gv-btn);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem}
.gv-date{font-family:var(--gv-d);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.04em}
.gv-date small{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gv-muted)}
.gv-date strong{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6vw,4.6rem);background:var(--gv-grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.gv-date em{display:block;font-family:var(--gv-b);font-style:italic;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--gv-lav);margin-top:6px}
.gv-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.gv-plat{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:1rem;color:var(--gv-muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.gv-plat li{list-style:none}.gv-plat li:last-child{color:var(--gv-sun)}
.gv-plat{padding:0;margin:0}
.gv-since{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--gv-muted)}.gv-since b{color:var(--gv-ink);font-weight:600}
.gv-scroll{position:absolute;bottom:26px;left:50%;translate:-50% 0;font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--gv-muted);animation:gvBob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes gvBob{50%{transform:translateY(6px)}}
/* ticker */
.gv-ticker{overflow:hidden;border-block:1px solid var(--gv-hair);background:#0b0c18;padding:12px 0}
.gv-ticker__t{display:flex;gap:42px;width:max-content;animation:gvMq 38s linear infinite;font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--gv-lav);text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.gv-ticker__t i{font-style:normal;color:var(--gv-hot)}
@keyframes gvMq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
/* scene sections with bg */
.gv-scene{position:relative;padding:clamp(70px,10vw,140px) 0;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.gv-scene__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:.55}
.gv-scene::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gv-bg) 0%,rgba(7,8,15,.55) 18%,rgba(7,8,15,.55) 82%,var(--gv-bg) 100%)}
.gv-promo{text-align:center}
.gv-promo .gv-h2{font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,7rem);background:var(--gv-grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.gv-promo__meta{font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.22em;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gv-ink);margin-bottom:22px}
/* cards */
.gv-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(14px,2vw,24px);margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,80px);perspective:1200px}
.gv-card{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;min-height:0;aspect-ratio:16/10;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--gv-ink);text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);background:#111;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .5s}
.gv-card img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.gv-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,8,15,0) 35%,rgba(7,8,15,.88) 100%)}
.gv-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.gv-card__b{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:clamp(18px,2.6vw,32px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;width:100%}
.gv-card--c .gv-card__b{align-items:center;text-align:center}
.gv-card__k{font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--gv-muted);font-size:1rem;text-transform:uppercase}
.gv-card__t{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.4vw,3.8rem);line-height:.92;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.gv-card__s{color:var(--gv-lav);font-weight:300;font-size:.98rem;margin:0}
.gv-play{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);margin-bottom:8px;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}
.gv-play::after{content:"";border-left:16px solid #fff;border-top:10px solid transparent;border-bottom:10px solid transparent;margin-left:4px}
.gv-card:hover .gv-play{transform:scale(1.08);background:rgba(255,45,149,.35)}
.gv-card--wide{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:21/9}
.gv-card--wide::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,8,15,.9) 0%,rgba(7,8,15,.5) 45%,rgba(7,8,15,0) 75%)}
.gv-card--wide .gv-card__b{max-width:560px;align-self:center}
.gv-card--wide .gv-card__s{color:var(--gv-muted);font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.6}
.gv-card--art{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a1840,#120e26 60%,#3a1530)}
.gv-card--art::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,8,15,.55),rgba(7,8,15,0) 60%)}
.gv-card--art .gv-card__b{align-self:center;max-width:58%}
.gv-card--art .gv-card__art{position:absolute;right:6%;top:50%;width:34%;aspect-ratio:1;height:auto;inset:auto 6% auto auto;translate:0 -50%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55);z-index:2;transform:rotate(3deg)}
.gv-card--art:hover .gv-card__art{transform:rotate(-1deg) translateY(-4px)}
/* story / walk */
.gv-story{text-align:center;padding:clamp(90px,12vw,170px) 0 0}
.gv-story .gv-h2{font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6.6rem)}
.gv-story p.gv-lede{margin:0 auto}
.gv-story__or{font-style:italic;color:var(--gv-lav);margin-top:18px}
.gv-walk{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(50px,7vw,90px);height:min(88vh,820px);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.gv-walk video,.gv-walk img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.gv-walk::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gv-bg),rgba(7,8,15,0) 22%,rgba(7,8,15,0) 60%,var(--gv-bg))}
.gv-walk__cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:9%;z-index:2;text-align:center}
.gv-walk__cap .gv-h2{margin:.1em 0;text-shadow:0 6px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
/* people */
.gv-people__intro{text-align:center;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}
.gv-people__intro .gv-lede{margin:0 auto}
.gv-person{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr);gap:clamp(22px,4vw,64px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(40px,6vw,80px) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--gv-hair)}
.gv-person:nth-child(even){grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(0,.92fr)}
.gv-person:nth-child(even) .gv-person__img{order:2}
.gv-person__img{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:3/4;box-shadow:0 40px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.6);transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .4s ease-out}
.gv-person__img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.gv-person__img::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:inherit}
.gv-person__name{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(3rem,7vw,6rem);line-height:.9;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 .2em;color:var(--acc,var(--gv-lav))}
.gv-person__q{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.4vw,2rem);letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.1;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--gv-ink)}
.gv-person p.gv-lede{margin:0 0 14px}
.gv-person__pull{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-size:1.4rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--acc,var(--gv-hot));text-transform:uppercase;margin:6px 0 16px!important}
/* locations */
.gv-head{max-width:820px;margin-bottom:clamp(30px,5vw,60px)}
.gv-locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(12px,1.6vw,20px)}
.gv-loc{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.gv-loc:first-child,.gv-loc:nth-child(2){aspect-ratio:16/10}
.gv-loc:first-child{grid-column:span 2}
.gv-loc:nth-child(2){grid-column:span 1;aspect-ratio:auto}
.gv-loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.gv-loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.gv-loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,8,15,0) 40%,rgba(7,8,15,.9))}
.gv-loc__b{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:clamp(16px,2.2vw,26px)}
.gv-loc__n{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3vw,2.6rem);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 6px}
.gv-loc__t{color:var(--gv-muted);font-size:.95rem;margin:0;max-width:46ch}
/* rap sheet */
.gv-rap{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%,rgba(139,92,246,.16),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 100%,rgba(255,45,149,.12),transparent 50%),var(--gv-bg2)}
.gv-sheet{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:clamp(24px,4vw,60px);align-items:start;background:#f3ecd9;color:#1b1724;border-radius:6px;padding:clamp(22px,3.4vw,46px);box-shadow:0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.55);transform:rotate(-.6deg);position:relative}
.gv-sheet::before{content:"WANTED";position:absolute;top:-22px;right:24px;background:#f3ecd9;font-family:var(--gv-d);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.4rem);letter-spacing:.08em;color:#c81e4a;border:3px solid #c81e4a;padding:0 12px;transform:rotate(6deg);opacity:.85}
.gv-mug{position:relative}
.gv-mug img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;border:6px solid #1b1724;background:#29245c}
.gv-mug figcaption{font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:1.05rem;margin-top:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.gv-mug figcaption b{font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em}
.gv-sheet h3{font-family:var(--gv-d);font-weight:400;font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 10px;color:#1b1724}
.gv-charges{list-style:none;margin:0 0 22px;padding:0;counter-reset:c}
.gv-charges li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(27,23,36,.3);padding:9px 0;font-weight:500;counter-increment:c}
.gv-charges li::before{content:counter(c,decimal-leading-zero);font-family:var(--gv-d);color:#c81e4a;margin-right:10px;font-size:1.1rem}
.gv-charges li span{flex:1}
.gv-charges li em{font-style:normal;color:#5b526e;font-size:.9rem;text-align:right}
.gv-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.gv-stats div{background:rgba(27,23,36,.07);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 12px}
.gv-stats dt{font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.85rem;color:#5b526e}
.gv-stats dd{margin:0;font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem}
/* media */
.gv-media{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(10px,1.4vw,18px)}
.gv-media figure{margin:0;position:relative;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/10;cursor:zoom-in;background:#111;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.gv-media figure:first-child{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2;aspect-ratio:auto}
.gv-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .8s}
.gv-media figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.gv-media figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:26px 14px 10px;font-family:var(--gv-d);letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:1rem;text-transform:uppercase;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(7,8,15,.85))}
.gv-lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:rgba(7,8,15,.92);display:none;place-items:center;padding:4vw;cursor:zoom-out}
.gv-lb.on{display:grid}.gv-lb img{max-width:100%;max-height:88vh;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px #000}
/* template market + buy sections restyled */
#market,#buy{background:var(--gv-bg)!important;color:var(--gv-ink)!important;border:0!important}
#market{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(255,45,149,.12),transparent 60%),var(--gv-bg2)!important}
#market .kicker,#buy .kicker{font-family:var(--gv-d)!important;letter-spacing:.22em!important;color:var(--gv-muted)!important;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:400!important}
#market .kicker b,#buy .kicker b{color:var(--gv-hot)!important}
